from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_monthly_account_target_gap_diagnostic_v1")
frame=pd.read_csv(OUT/"01_四原账户三时期目标缺口.csv")
frame=frame[frame["period"].eq("主要期2024—2025")&frame["case_id"].isin(["joint_200000","joint_20000"])]
assert list(frame["case_id"])==["joint_200000","joint_20000"]
font=FontProperties(fname=r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6.3))
fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=.20,top=.88,left=.10,right=.97)
x=[0,1];width=.25
series=[("原费用后",frame["cagr"].to_numpy()*100,"#346b9b"),
        ("原持仓费用返还",frame["same_holdings_refund_cagr"].to_numpy()*100,"#73a3bf"),
        ("事后完美半仓原路径上限",frame["perfect_hindsight_50_no_fee_same_exit_path_cagr_ceiling"].to_numpy()*100,"#d9b866")]
for i,(label,values,color) in enumerate(series):
    bars=ax.bar([a+(i-1)*width for a in x],values,width,label=label,color=color)
    for bar,value in zip(bars,values):
        ax.text(bar.get_x()+bar.get_width()/2,bar.get_height()+.12,f"{value:.2f}%",ha="center",fontproperties=font,fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(10,color="#b54444",linestyle="--",linewidth=1.5)
ax.text(1.28,10.12,"10%年化目标",ha="right",fontproperties=font,color="#b54444")
ax.set_xticks(x,["20万元主账户","2万元费用比较"],fontproperties=font)
ax.set_ylim(0,11.5);ax.set_ylabel("年化收益率（%）",fontproperties=font)
ax.set_title("原M2主期：费用与原交易路径不足以填补收益缺口",fontproperties=font,fontsize=15,pad=14)
ax.legend(prop=font,loc="upper left",frameon=False)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.18);ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.text(.5,.075,"2024—2025；全部现金日计入。返费和事后上限均是解释路径，不是可执行账户。",ha="center",fontproperties=font,fontsize=9,color="#555555")
fig.savefig(OUT/"原M2完整账户收益缺口.png",dpi=160,bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)
print("图中文字位置已修订；金融输入与计算结果未改变。")
